tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// shrī wan+saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya karma na thā ya na maḥ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /srid gsum zil gnon nag po chen po yi/ /bka' nyan las kyi pho nya drag shul can/ /mthu rtsal thogs med gnod sbyin pho mo dang / 1 /'phrin las mgon po mon bu pu tra khyod/ /sngon tshe 'phags yul dben pa'i ri brag tu/ /bram ze'i rigs las bden tshig grub pa'i mthus/ /gshin rje gsod byed ces grags bdag la dgongs/ 2 /gzhan yang dus der bram ze ming sring gnyis/ /smon lam mthu yis bdud dang gnod sbyin gyi/ /gtso bor gyur pa nag po bha ṭa dang / /sring mo kha 'bar ru 'dren sde bzhir bcas/ 3 /mon pa pho mo sprul pa yang sprul dang / /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs/ /yid ltar mgyogs shing rdzu 'phrul bsam yas pa'i/ /las mkhan 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ 4 /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin rim par byon rnams kyis/ /rgyun chad med par bsten cing bsgrub mdzad pas/ /mthu ldan khyed rnams dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dri med gcig tu bsrung bar mdzad/ 5 /de phyir sa skya'i rje btsun bka'i srung ma/ /mnyes byed phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul sa gzhi bar snang kun/ /khyab par bkang ste 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ 6 /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /ma lus las mkhan 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mchod sprin khams su gang bar sprul nas 'bul/ 7 /'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /rgyud mi chad par 'byung zhing rgyas gyur cig /de la brten nas gsang ba'i las mkhan che/ /'khor bcas dgyes pa'i thugs kyang de 'drar mdzod/

8 /gang gi sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las tshogs rnams spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i/ /rgyal ba rnams dang dbyer med zhugs pa yi/ /las mkhan chen po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ 9 /dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la/ /log lta bgyis sogs bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /tshor dang ma tshor mi dge ci bgyis pa/ /snying nas 'gyod pa chen pos so sor bshag 10 /bdag cag rnams kyi sngon bsags las ngan gyis/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal myong gyur ci mchis pa/ /tshe 'dir dge la spro ba'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /zhi bar gyur nas sdig 'bras med par mdzod/ 11 /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag la yid gtad pa'i/ /dad ldan rdo rje slob ma 'di dag kun/ /las mkhan khyed la gnyer du gtad lags kyis/ /skad cig 'bral med 'di phyi'i don kun sgrubs/ 12 /rang gi zhe sdang phyi rol dgra 'dre'i gzugs/ /bla ma bstan dang bsgrub la gnod byed rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyang rnam shes chos dbyings sgrol/ /rang gzhan sdig gis gos pa med par mdzod/ 13 /sa skya'i bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas bsam pa bzhin/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog /rigs rgyud rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar mdzod/ 14 /bdag 'dra nyon mongs bye bas rgyud gtams kyang / /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bka' srung khyed kyi mthus/ /phyi ma bdag cag dpon slob lhan cig par/ /thogs med bde ba can du skye bar mdzod/ 15 /slar yang gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /bstan pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyas byed cing / /mdor na 'di phyi'i bsam don ma lus pa/ /yid bzhin 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ 16 /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /dam can pū tra chen po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub mdzod/ 17 /ces dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs bcad don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos las mgon pu tra chen po 'di nyid rang la snying nye zhing thugs rje myur bar 'phral dang yun du yid ches khyad par can yang yang rnyed pas rkyen byas te las mkhan chen por dad pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis sprel lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i nyer dgu'i nyin dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang /

yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so/ /'dis bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ mgon po putra chen po 'khor bcas la mchod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
